season.evidence: Web search: club route page lists the area June through October; one route page suggests spring. Reports show snow in the upper basin and a moat in late June and mid-July. Histogram all routes: May 4, Jul 16, Aug 7, Oct 4. Stored Jun-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: 2025-07-11, blank logged route; its high point is within 21 m of the surveyed highest-summit coordinate, and the report climbs a ramp from a saddle, not the south chimney described here.
Logged Standard route, which we hold as its own route; not a complete trip.

facts.text: As of late May 2026 a gate stands near the old trailhead and the trail now starts from a small lot (4-5 cars) at the end of a narrow logging road; a short descent leads to the first log crossing.
The Kachess River and Mineral Creek are both crossed on logs in June and July; the logs are bare and slick, so some parties sit and shuffle across.

season.evidence: Web search: club route page lists June-October for the area; one October ascent recorded. Stored Jul-Oct kept. A wildfire closure notice (Aug 2026) affects trailheads here.

notes: The harvested tracks (2901430, 1893454) reach the Peakbagger highest-summit coordinate (East Peak, 47.44636, -121.27031); none targets the Middle or West subpeak, and we have no Summit pins for those routes. Standard Scramble already has track points and was not in the request. A closure notice for a 2026 fire near Three Queens was seen on the Spectacle Lake page.
